name: Sound Group Inc. American Depositary Shares
summary: Sound Group Inc. operates as an entertainment and social enterprise, with a core focus on audio experiences. Its main objective is to develop audio-based platforms that enable users to connect and communicate. Leveraging its comprehensive product offerings and proprietary technologies, the company serves the demand for audio entertainment and social engagement. Founded in Singapore in 2010, the entity was previously known as LIZHI INC. before officially rebranding to Sound Group Inc. in January 2024.
